description: This Java source file defines the InProcessLauncher class, which is used to programmatically launch Spark applications within the same JVM process. It includes methods for starting applications, finding the SparkSubmit class, and managing application handles.

classes.name: InProcessLauncher
classes.description: A launcher class for starting Spark applications within the same JVM process, supporting both client and cluster modes.

methods.name: startApplication
methods.description: Starts a Spark application, sets up communication with the launcher server, and returns a handle to the application.

methods.name: self
methods.description: Returns the current instance of InProcessLauncher.

methods.name: findSparkSubmit
methods.description: Locates the SparkSubmit class and its main method via reflection, trying different class names for compatibility.
